name: (03) Obfuscate — 2 Intermediate — Mask of a Thousand Faces

system.description:
You twist the perceptions of those around you, causing them to see not your true face but a bland stranger's, or any specific visage you choose to wear.

By default your features seem unremarkable, and observers can describe you only in vague terms. Spend a Mental Trait to assume a specific set of features instead, altering how you look, sound and smell to all who do not pierce the disguise; it does not change anything you wear or carry. The Mask lasts until you sleep, are knocked unconscious or torpid, or are killed. You keep your own Social Traits, but to impersonate someone of higher Social Traits you must spend Blood Traits to match their total, and you can never exceed the cap of your generation.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
